scenarios.name: mirror-farm
scenarios.description: One publisher/upstream fans out N mirrors, reprints and renames with distinct URLs and accounts. No new observation exists.
scenarios.expected: Collapse to one group; independent weight 1 regardless of N; correlation cap binds.

scenarios.name: anchorless-mutual-praise
scenarios.description: A disconnected cluster with high mutual ratings and no pre-trusted anchor. No external grounding.
scenarios.expected: No enforcement effect; at most a flagged recommendation. EigenTrust without anchor yields no trust substitution.

scenarios.name: provenance-laundering-plus-span-gaming
scenarios.description: Shared source hidden behind distinct publisher/group labels, missing or substituted provenance, plus split/overlapping spans and reformatted copies presented as fresh evidence.
scenarios.expected: Laundered items fail as non-gold; split/overlap/reformat collapse; no false independence and no cap bypass.

scenarios.name: lifecycle-replay
scenarios.description: Revoked or superseded evidence, scope/claim-version change, stale cache replay attempting resurrection or history erasure.
scenarios.expected: Old evidence excluded; replay/cache fails closed; history preserved.

scenarios.name: reputation-as-authority
scenarios.description: High Beta/EigenTrust score, or an external 'trusted/independent' assertion, offered as a substitute for policy authorization or evidence gates.
scenarios.expected: Firewall blocks; score is advisory only; authority unchanged.

benign_reference.name: benign-near-miss
benign_reference.description: Genuinely independent primary observations with identical text and transparent provenance.
benign_reference.expected: Full independent weight; no lexical merge; valid alternates not failed.

publication_threat.name: evaluator-publication-tamper
publication_threat.description: Missing/extra/duplicate cases, null hashes, unknown Git objects, A/B identity collision, bad traces, cached PASS with failed B.
publication_threat.expected: Publication of READY is blocked (nonzero exit, no new ready record).
